learn.title: A slice of a circle
learn.body: A sector is a pie-slice of a circle, bounded by two radii and an arc. If the central angle is $\theta$ degrees, the slice is the fraction $\frac{\theta}{360}$ of the whole circle.

learn.title: Two formulas
learn.body: Arc length $=\frac{\theta}{360}\cdot2\pi r$. Sector area $=\frac{\theta}{360}\cdot\pi r^2$. Each is the same fraction of the whole circle's circumference or area.

learn.title: Compute with fractions
learn.body: Take $r=6$ and a central angle of $60^\circ$.

questions.explanation: The arc is a part of the distance around the circle.

questions.prompt: On a circle with radius 12, an arc is $4\pi$ long. What is the central angle in degrees?
questions.explanation: The circumference is $24\pi$, and $\frac{4\pi}{24\pi}=\frac16$ of $360$ is $60$.
